dataset.name: samld
dataset.label_definition: positive = the account is the sender or the receiver of at least one transaction whose published Is_laundering flag is 1. SAML-D labels transactions; this entity label is derived, and it makes a launderer's counterparty positive as well
notes: SAML-D is generated from declared typologies. Results on it are evidence about a simulator, not about real-world detection.
Amounts are native across 13 currencies (95.7% GBP) and are not FX-converted; the amount column is 'amount', not 'amount_usd'.
The published Laundering_type column is an exact alias of the label and is not loaded.
Version is derived from file size and mtime, not a content hash.
